name: index-checklist
title: The entry point the workflow promises, and the two sections it says are there
description: Measured: .trellis/workflow.md says a spec index is the entry point with a Pre-Development Checklist and a Quality Check, the trellis-before-dev skill tells every agent to read the files listed in that checklist, and neither index has either section - while quality-guidelines.md is the Quality Check under another name. A broken pointer between the tool own docs and this repository entry points
